command:sh -c node -e 'const J=p=>JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(p));const fs=require("fs");let n=0,facts=0;for(const f of fs.readdirSync("evidence/D28/results")){const r=J("evidence/D28/results/"+f);const bad=Object.entries(r.facts).filter(([k,v])=>v.verdict!=="PASS").map(([k])=>k);if(bad.length||r.commands.some(c=>c.exit!==0)){console.log(r.group,"FAIL",bad);process.exit(1)}n++;facts+=Object.keys(r.facts).length}const s=J("evidence/D28/selection.json");console.log("groups",n,"facts re-proved",facts,"selected",s.selected);if(facts!==s.selected)process.exit(1)'
